en.title: India Congress youth wing warns of more protests against Meta after police clashes
en.dek: Congress youth wing threatens further protests against Meta following police clashes outside its offices.
facts: Congress party youth wing clashed with police outside Meta offices in India on Friday.
Protests were in response to Meta's removal of some accounts and posts belonging to Congress members.
Meta declined to comment on Friday's protests.
Debate is growing in India about potential risks to free speech from the government's efforts to remove social media content it objects to.
body: The youth wing of India's main opposition Congress party on Saturday warned of more protests against Meta after clashing with police outside the US firm's offices in India on Friday, according to Dawn.
The protests followed the removal of some accounts and posts belonging to Congress members, which the party says triggered the confrontation.

Meta declined to comment on the clashes, which occurred as debate grows in India about potential risks to free speech from the government's efforts to remove social media content it objects to, as reported by Dawn.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government says it orders content to be taken down only if it breaches local laws, according to Dawn.
en.context: The Congress party, as India's main opposition group, has been vocal in its criticism of Meta's content moderation decisions, which it views as targeting its members, according to Dawn reporting.

fr.title: Congrès de la jeunesse du Congrès indien averti de nouvelles manifestations contre Meta après des affrontements avec la police
fr.dek: La jeunesse du Congrès menace de nouvelles manifestations contre Meta suite à des affrontements avec la police devant ses bureaux.
facts: Congrès de la jeunesse du Congrès indienne en conflit avec la police devant les bureaux de Meta vendredi
Manifestations en réponse au retrait par Meta de comptes et de publications appartenant à des membres du Congrès
Meta a refusé de commenter les manifestations de vendredi
Débat croissant en Inde sur les risques potentiels pour la liberté d'expression liés aux efforts du gouvernement de supprimer les contenus des réseaux sociaux
body: Le wing de la jeunesse du parti du Congrès, principale formation d'opposition en Inde, a averti samedi de nouvelles manifestations contre Meta, suite à des affrontements avec la police devant les bureaux de l'entreprise américaine vendredi, selon Dawn.
Les protestations ont fait suite au retrait de certains comptes et publications appartenant à des membres du Congrès, que le parti affirme avoir déclenché l'affrontement.

Meta a refusé de commenter les affrontements, qui interviennent alors que se développe en Inde un débat sur les risques potentiels pour la liberté d'expression liés aux efforts du gouvernement de supprimer les contenus des réseaux sociaux qu'il conteste, selon Dawn.
Le gouvernement du Premier ministre Narendra Modi affirme ne ordonner la suppression de contenus que s'ils violent les lois locales, selon Dawn.
fr.context: Le parti Congrès, principal groupe d'opposition en Inde, s'est montré critique à l'égard des décisions de modération de contenu de Meta, qu'il considère comme ciblant ses membres, selon les informations de Dawn. @@CAPTION||

es.title: La juventud del Congreso advierte de más protestas contra Meta tras choques con la policía
es.dek: La juventud del Congreso amenaza con nuevas protestas contra Meta tras choques con la policía frente a sus oficinas.
facts: Congresistas juveniles chocaron con la policía frente a las oficinas de Meta en India el viernes.
Las protestas fueron una respuesta a la eliminación por parte de Meta de algunas cuentas y publicaciones de miembros del Congreso.
Meta se negó a comentar los protestas del viernes.
El debate crece en India sobre los riesgos potenciales a la libertad de expresión derivados de los esfuerzos del gobierno por eliminar contenido en redes sociales que objetan.
body: La juventud del Congreso advierte de más protestas contra Meta tras choques con la policía
Los protestas siguieron a la retirada de algunas cuentas y publicaciones pertenecientes a miembros del Congreso, que el partido dice que desencadenaron el enfrentamiento.

Meta se negó a hacer comentarios sobre los choques, que ocurrieron mientras crece el debate en India sobre los riesgos potenciales a la libertad de expresión derivados de los esfuerzos del gobierno por retirar contenido de redes sociales que objetan, según Dawn.
El gobierno del primer ministro Narendra Modi dice que ordena retirar contenido solo si infringe leyes locales, según Dawn.
es.context: El Congreso, como principal grupo de oposición en India, ha sido vocal en su crítica a las decisiones de moderación de contenido de Meta, las cuales considera que apuntan a sus miembros, según el reporte de Dawn.

pt.title: A juventude do Congresso alerta para mais protestos contra o Meta após confrontos com a polícia
pt.dek: Juventude do Congresso ameaça novos protestos contra o Meta após confrontos com a polícia em frente às suas sedes.
facts: Congresso jovem confrontou a polícia fora das sedes do Meta na Índia na sexta-feira.
Protestos foram em resposta à remoção de contas e publicações de membros do Congresso pelo Meta.
O Meta recusou comentar os protestos de sexta-feira.
Debate cresce na Índia sobre potenciais riscos à liberdade de expressão nos esforços do governo para remover conteúdos de redes sociais que objeta.
body: A juventude do Congresso alerta para mais protestos contra o Meta após confrontos com a polícia
Os protestos seguiram-se à remoção de algumas contas e publicações pertencentes a membros do Congresso, que o partido diz ter desencadeado o confronto.

O Meta recusou comentar os confrontos, que ocorreram enquanto cresce o debate na Índia sobre potenciais riscos à liberdade de expressão dos esforços do governo para remover conteúdos de redes sociais que este objecta, segundo o Dawn.
O governo do primeiro-ministro Narendra Modi diz que ordena a remoção de conteúdos apenas se estes violarem as leis locais, segundo o Dawn.
pt.context: O Partido Congresso, como principal grupo de oposição da Índia, tem sido vocal na sua crítica às decisões de moderação de conteúdo do Meta, que considera como a atacar os seus membros, segundo o reporting do Dawn.

zh.title: 印度青年国大党警告将在Meta办公室冲突后继续抗议
zh.dek: 国大党青年翼警告在印度Meta办公室发生警民冲突后将进行进一步抗议
facts: 国大党青年翼周五在印度Meta办公室外与警方冲突
此次抗议是对Meta删除部分国会议员账号和帖子的回应
Meta拒绝就周五的抗议事宜发表评论
印度关于政府为打击其不满的社交媒体内容而采取行动可能对言论自由构成风险的争论日益升温
body: 印度青年国大党警告将在Meta办公室冲突后继续抗议
抗议活动始于周五，国大党青年翼成员在印度Meta办公室外与警方冲突。此前，Meta移除了部分国大党成员的账号和帖子，国大党称此举引发了冲突。
Meta拒绝就冲突事宜发表评论。此次冲突发生之际，印度关于政府为移除其认为不当的社交媒体内容而展开的辩论日益升温，可能对言论自由构成风险。此报道据《黎明报》。
据《黎明报》报道，莫迪总理政府表示，仅在内容违反当地法律的情况下，才会下令移除内容。
zh.context: 作为印度主要的在野党，国大党一直公开批评Meta的内容审判决定，认为这些决定针对其成员，据《晨报》报道

ko.title: 인도 청년 Congress, 경찰 충돌 후 메타에 대한 시위 경고
ko.dek: Congress 청년翼, 경찰 충돌 이후 메타에 대한 추가 시위 위협
facts: 청년 Congress翼이 금요일에 인도 메타 사무실 앞에서 경찰과 충돌
Congress翼이 일부 Congress 의원 계정 및 게시물 삭제에 대응해 시위
Meta가 금요일 시위에 대해 코멘트 거부
인도에서 정부가 비판하는 소셜 미디어 콘텐츠 삭제와 관련해 자유 발언 위험에 대한 논의 확대
body: 인도 청년 Congress가 경찰과 충돌한 후 메타에 대한 시위 경고를 발표했다. Dawn에 따르면, 이는 금요일에 인도 내 미국 기업 메타 사무실 앞에서 발생한 충돌 이후다.
시위는 Congress 소속 일부 계정과 게시물 삭제 이후 발생했다. 당은 이 삭제가 충돌을 촉발했다고 보고 있다.
Meta는 충돌에 대해 언급을 거부했다. Dawn에 따르면, 이는 인도 정부가 비판하는 소셜 미디어 콘텐츠를 제거하려는 노력과 관련해 현지에서 자유 발언에 대한 위험에 대한 논의가 진행되는 가운데 발생했다.
Dawn에 따르면, 나렌드라 모디 총리의 정부는 현지 법률을 위반할 경우에만 콘텐츠를 삭제하도록 명령한다고 한다.
ko.context: 인도 최대 야당인 Congress당은 자당 멤버를 타겟팅한다는 이유로 메타의 콘텐츠 moderation 결정을 비판해 왔으며, Dawn 보도에 따르면 그러한 입장을 취하고 있다.

problemsFixed: Facts not in sources: 'Meta's biggest market by users' is not in S1; 'unprecedented protests' is opinion; 'escalation' is evaluative; 'debate is growing' is vague and not attributed to a specific source in the body; 'strict efforts' is evaluative; 'government says it orders content removal only if it breaches local laws or can harm public safety' adds 'or can harm public safety' which is not in S1 text (S1 cuts off).
Neutral verbs: 'warned of more protests' is acceptable but 'marked an escalation' is not a neutral verb; 'declined to comment' is fine but context needs attribution.
Headline: 55 chars but 'escalation' is loaded language.
Body: Sentence 3 repeats 'Meta declined to comment on the clashes' idea from sentence 2; sentence 4 introduces 'debate grows' without proper attribution in the flow.
Rhythm: Four short declarative sentences in a row in the body.
Context: Uses 'views as targeting its members' which is not in sources; sources only report Congress's warning, not that Meta is targeting them.
No evaluative framing: 'marked an escalation', 'growing debate', 'strict efforts' must be removed or attributed.
